characters.name: Коля
facts: Kolya was hiding in a container on the cargo ship.
He witnessed the arrival of a group of small robots and the discovery of two people hiding.
He overheard the conversation between the people and the security personnel.
knowledge: He knew about the weight of the 'rabbits' (people) and the weight loss on the cargo.
He recognized the captain of the ship.
goals: To leave the ship and return home.
relationships: He overheard a conversation between the security personnel and the people who were hiding.

characters.name: Тележка
facts: The cargo had lost 193.682 kg.
The weight of the 'rabbits' was 43.682 kg and 150 kg respectively.
The weight loss was confirmed.
knowledge: The weight of the 'rabbits' and the weight loss.

characters.name: Вахтенный
facts: He was in charge of security on the ship.
He discovered two people hiding in the cargo.
He questioned the people about their presence on the ship.
knowledge: He knew about the weight loss on the cargo.
He recognized the captain of the ship.
goals: To ensure the safety and order on the ship.
relationships: He questioned the people who were hiding.
evidence: Взвесьте тех, кто скрывался, сообщите мне.

characters.name: Капитан Полосков
facts: He was the captain of the ship.
He was informed about the incident by the security personnel.
He was familiar with the people who were hiding.
knowledge: He recognized the people who were hiding.
He knew about the cargo and its destination.
goals: To maintain order and safety on the ship.
relationships: He was informed about the incident by the security personnel.

characters.name: Толстяк и худенький
facts: They were hiding in the cargo.
They claimed to be going to Pluto to visit their mother.
They were mistaken for people going to Mars.
knowledge: They knew about the weight of the 'rabbits' and the weight loss.
goals: To avoid being caught and to return home.
evidence: Вес моего человека сорок три килограмма шестьсот восемьдесят два грамма.
Вес моего человека сто пятьдесят килограммов ровно.
